testing_universes.policy: top count-ranked features available to each BMR; consensus uses only exact pairs tested by all three

sample_mapping.fallback_policy: samples absent from the MutSig patient axis receive the gene-specific cohort-mean lambda

mutsig.feature_origin_policy: MutSig per-sample lambda when the base gene is present on the MutSig gene axis; otherwise the cohort CBaSE PMF is used
